name: robots/novog93__sjtu_drone
title: sjtu_drone Gazebo quadrotor simulation
intro: sjtu_drone Gazebo quadrotor simulation, adapted from novog93/sjtu_drone. It reads `read_last_cmd_vel`, `read_state`, `read_pose` and `read_mode`; runs `takeoff`, `land`, `reset`, `publish_cmd_vel` and 3 more. `takeoff`: publish one std_msgs/Empty on /simple_drone/takeoff. The callback only moves the state machine from LANDED_MODEL to TAKINGOFF_MODEL; the receipt proves the publication, not that the simulated drone left the ground. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
